 Country Fans Forced the CMAs to Reverse Its Invitation Snub of Rodney Atkins
 Men's Journal Follow Amelia Harvey Add to Preferred Sources Sat, November 14, 2026 at 5:19 PM UTC Country Fans Forced the CMAs to Reverse Its Invitation Snub of Rodney Atkins Rodney Atkins has changed his mind and will attend the 2026 CMA Awards following a previous red carpet snub.
 Atkins shared an Instagram video on Saturday, Nov. 7, which claimed he, along with Sammy Kershaw, were not invited to attend the upcoming CMA Awards red carpet . Less than a week later, he updated fans and revealed he will be attending the illustrious country music event.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement "After some good conversations between our team and the CMA, Rose and I have decided we'll be walking the red carpet and attending this year's awards," Atkins said, referring to his wife Rose Falcon.
 "I'm grateful to the CMA for hearing us out, and I can't thank y'all enough for all the love and support. Once again, you reminded me just how powerful country music fans can be when they speak up," the 57-year-old singer added.
 The singer appears to want to move forward and not hold any grudges. "Life's too short, and the days are long, but the years are short," said the "Caught Up in the Country" singer. "Looking forward to a great night celebrating country music with old friends and new ones."
 He then joked, "Now I've just gotta find a red-carpet-worthy ball cap."
 Advertisement Advertisement The CMAs courted controversy when country icons Rodney Atkins and Sammy Kershaw revealed they hadn't been invited to the annual celebration of music.
 "When I heard about Sammy, I thought, 'What a shame. He's a great guy—sweetheart of a dude. Singing dude, spent his life representing country music… then I found out same thing happened to me. And in a way, I get it. I've always been kind of an outsider—maybe a shrub in the landscape of country music," Atkins had previously stated about the snub . 
 Kershaw also confirmed he'd be attending the CMA Awards after his previous grievances with the awards show's organizers.  "After a lot of thought and prayer, [my wife] Mendy and I have decided to accept the CMA's invitation to walk the red carpet and attend the awards," the "She Don't Know She's Beautiful" singer wrote on Instagram .
 This story was originally published by Men's Journal on Nov 14, 2026, where it first appeared in the Entertainment section. Add Men's Journal as a Preferred Source by clicking here.
